rule: A source enters D only because it supplies a named input required by accepted A-C. A binding describes the source itself, not the investigation history. First-party Osservatorio records are ordinary operator inputs, not an external authority problem.

sources.purpose: Supply the observed sample, plant or survey unit; sampling date and location; species; published result; and links to the confirming report.
routes: https://dati.puglia.it/ckan/dataset/dati-monitoraggio-xylella-fastidiosa
https://webapps.sit.puglia.it/arcgis/rest/services
https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/gps/mtdcrept/accuracy/index.htm (device term, corpus/sources/positional-qualification/records.json)

https://www.istat.it/storage/cartografia/confini_amministrativi/non_generalizzati/2026/Limiti01012026.zip (Puglia's extent for the grid distortion, same record)
sources.population: Every record of the twelve campaign workbooks, the CKAN release and the 101 observation point layers of the eight SIT services that publish them: 4,318,100 observations, 2,320,354 distinct, all hosts and all result states.

sources.open: Cross-release identity is unreliable for 2013–2017: the workbooks carry no reference and the SIT views use daily counters. A counter value one view reuses on a day stays uncorrelated; one used once in each of two views still correlates them, and such groups are exposed as disagreements or cannot be told from coincidence. The positional qualification is a stated device term plus grid distortion, against the ground. Not held: the device and capture mode per record (GNSS fix or map placement), per-fix accuracy, re-sample links, and the device before late 2024. Plant identity and the official finding belong to the population and report rows.

EU quarantine-pest and host listings retained under regulation/closure/eu/

Priority-pest status: Stage A's EU 2019/1702 dependency (regulation/stage-a/dependency-manifest.csv row EU2019-1702). The jurisdiction manifest resolves it (RESOLVED_ACCEPTED_EU_DEPENDENCY) for IT-DLGS-19-2021:Art.26(1):prepare-emergency-plan:v1 only; IT-DLGS-19-2021:Art.30(2):v1 has no EU 2019/1702 edge there, its declared dependency being Art.28(3)

sources.reader: Stage B parameters supply the stated survey values; pest-classification's two priority-pest predicates are owned by Stage A's EU2019-1702 dependency; D adds no reader and keeps no copy of the list; the finite population and strata per campaign are established with the plant and surface population row
sources.open: Establish the per-campaign target population and strata when the plant and surface population row exists. pest-classification stays open: its two consumers, Art.26(1) (the central service's emergency plan) and Art.30(2) (the National Plant Health Committee's information methods), lie outside the Osservatorio's positive-finding-to-removal chain, no C function reads either, C answers unknown there, and no supply is built.

sources.name: Official laboratory result documents
sources.purpose: Supply the laboratory's stated result for each designated test with its analyte, the sample identity, and the report's identity and dates for the samples the report names.
routes: DOCUMENTO_CONFERMA and LNK_DOCUMENTO_SELGE links published in regional monitoring records
https://webadf.sit.puglia.it/openDoc/apridocumento (confirmation letters and rapporti di prova)
http://cartografia.sit.puglia.it/doc/xylella/ (subspecies-identification rapporti)
sources.population: Every report referenced by an admitted monitoring release, followed through consequential report, annex and correction relationships.
sources.reader: cordon_d.reports, cordon_d.report_relations and cordon_d.findings; explicit extraction through scripts/read_reports.py
sources.open: SPEC.md owns which laboratory rows are completed. Inside the reach, a row or observation stays open with the cause its reading establishes: a publisher reference the reading does not recover, a printed reference no routed observation claims, a source association that conflicts with the row's host or printed coordinates or needs a host the row leaves unresolved, a conflicting or unstated sampling date, a report the source declares superseded, or a result part the source does not bind to a sample. Predecessor candidates retain unverified identity components; issue dates and referenced predecessor dates remain distinct. Administrative annexes can establish a derived occurrence correspondence without equating identifier strings. For sample-custody, the printed delivery and acceptance dates supply the delivery and the laboratory's receipt at date precision only: never an instant (custody_facts takes instants, and a printed date is never turned into one), never refrigerated transport and never the signatures, which stay with the handover record in osservatorio-records.

https://webapps.sit.puglia.it/arcgis/rest/services/ServicesArcIMS/RetiGeodetiche/MapServer (the Region's surveyed control fixes, corpus/sources/areas/cadastral-control.json)
Row 1's located positives and positional qualification (monitoring-records), for the infected plants an act names
sources.population: Every consumed A area version whose interval overlaps the reach, and the provinces, comuni, sheets and parcels its construction uses; acquisitions and the method of each source's positional error in corpus/sources/areas/geometry.json.
sources.reader: cordon_d.area_geometry.adopted_geography, from cordon_d.areas, cordon_d.administrative, cordon_d.area_error and row 1 (cordon_d.monitoring.distinct_observations, cordon_d.spatial.positional_terms)
sources.open: A zone the act defines around the infected plants it names is built around the row 1 positives the act names, each with row 1's measured error; for a listed unit no such plant's circle reaches, around the Region's layer where it carries the act's circles, else around the unit with the unit's extent in its error, so C answers neither way there (DDS 106/2025, Santeramo in Colle foglio 25). A band drawn from plants is held to the units the annex lists; where band and annex still disagree, the disputed land carries its reach in the error of any place that may have part in it: a place within its own error plus the error of the sources drawing the land's edge there (read as the area's own outline error is), or, along the edge the land shares with the listed units, a place overlapping it by more than 1 m². The cadastral error is measured against the Region's surveyed control fixes matched to the features the map draws; ISTAT's against the cadastral border where its line draws part of a zone; the Region's layer's against the cadastral outline of the units the act places wholly. The measurements are computed on read and cached in the derived store. DDS 148/2024 (2024-11-12 to 2024-12-18) is not held, so row 3 is not established for that interval.

sources.name: Osservatorio removal determinations and incorporated annexes
sources.purpose: Supply the issued removal measure, its operative branch, date, referenced plants or parcels, and any explicit supplement or correction.
routes: https://burp.regione.puglia.it/bollettini
https://www.regione.puglia.it/documents/736605/
https://cartografia.sit.puglia.it/doc/xylella/ (determinations reached from admitted report identities)
https://mdp.giustizia-amministrativa.it/visualizza/ (TAR Puglia and Consiglio di Stato decisions on an order, GA XML: the annulment basis)
https://openga.giustizia-amministrativa.it (Consiglio di Stato decision indexes searched for appeals)
sources.population: Every Osservatorio removal order, admitted by liveness: an order is in the population until execution or withdrawal closes it. Each order brings every held act that states a change to it and every court decision on it.
sources.reader: cordon_d.case_prescriptions (each order's whole operative text); cordon_d.held_acts (the changes held acts state to an order); cordon_d.judgments (the annulment basis: the court's own disposition); cordon_d.source_associations (native plant/report annex associations); cordon_d.annex_positions (annex positions, read only for the orders an in-force governing row names with a predicate bound to a position field). Other orders' annex positions remain unread. Whether a 50 m listing places no recipient is a lexical test (no parcel number; a parcel number with an empty owner cell; or an owner printed NON INDIVIDUAT… or NON TROVAT…), verified on the held annexes of the five orders DDS 18/2024 names and of DDS 115/2023; a governing row that names another order re-verifies it on that order's annex, blank owner cells included, since a blank cell at a page boundary may be a merged cell continued from the row above.
sources.open: Annex positions are read only for the orders an in-force governing row names with a predicate bound to a position field; for every other order they remain unread, so the plants and parcels it lists by position do not reach C from the order. Annex association reading does not establish administrative effect, withdrawal or whole-document coverage. A change a held act states that no A row records leaves the order's dueness unknown. Resolve page-boundary fragments and the conflicting earlier administrative target reached by a laboratory identifier correction; INPUTS.md row 6 owns the dependency.

The competent municipality's albo pretorio record of the seven-day publication; a retained publication certificate (Comune di Bari) is read only from its stored reading (replay-only), and a certificate with no stored reading is not read
https://burp.regione.puglia.it/bollettini and the regional sites the plans name

OpenWeb albo register exports (openweb/albo/csv.php): the competent municipality's (Fasano, Modugno, Montemesola); ARIF's own albo (arif.soluzionipa.it) is read as a lead to removal the named recipients performed (row 11) and supplies no notice

JCityGov albo detail pages and their posted documents (papca/display): only Taranto (taranto.trasparenza-valutazione-merito.it), the one comune read_postings.py reads; other towns' JCityGov pages are not read
TAR decisions stating an order's delivery, posting, request or reply (the removal-orders court route)

sources.open: Select the source by the Law 241 Article 21-bis route A selects for the act and recipient; an immediate-effect or cautionary clause makes the measure operative but is not notification. A publication record proves the publication duty; by itself it establishes neither recipient effect nor silence, refusal, breach or cost liability. Sending, delivery, publication, recipient effectiveness and response stay distinct.

sources.purpose: Supply an individual plant's protected status from every instrument that gives monumental or historic-interest status.
routes: https://webapps.sit.puglia.it/arcgis/rest/services/Operationals/UliviMonumentali/MapServer/1 (listed trees) and /0 (provisional trees, DGR 720/2025), captured whole by scripts/acquire_protection.py (corpus/sources/protected-status/register.json)

The L.R. 14/2007 list acts as published on BURP (https://burp.regione.puglia.it/documents/20135/<folder>/DEL_<n>_<year>.pdf, or the ordinary bulletin that carries an older act), each act's decision, history table and deletion annex (corpus/sources/protected-status/acts.json)

The elenco degli alberi monumentali d'Italia (L. 10/2013 Art. 7) as MASAF publishes it (https://www.masaf.gov.it/flex/cm/pages/ServeBLOB.php/L/IT/IDPagina/11260 and the decree pages its national rules page 11268 links): the current Puglia sheet, each approving or updating decree with its annexes, the census method of 23 October 2014, and each decree's notice in the G.U.; captured by scripts/acquire_protection.py national-list (corpus/sources/protected-status/national-list.json)

The declarations of notable public interest (D.lgs. 42/2004 Art. 136): the SIT layer "Immobili e aree di notevole interesse pubblico" of Operationals/PPTR_APPROVATO in every PPTR version the service publishes; the G.U. issue that published each declaration's decree, placed through the G.U.'s yearly archive where the layer's number or date names none, and each ordinary supplement the issue's own G.U. index places an act of notable public interest in; the PPTR's scheda (elaborato 6.4, https://pugliacon.regione.puglia.it/web/sit-puglia-paesaggio) of each declaration whose layer motivation reaches the field's length; and the G.U. issues since the PPTR version before the latest, for declarations the layer does not yet print; captured by scripts/acquire_protection.py declarations, declaration-decrees, declaration-supplements, declaration-schede and declaration-search (corpus/sources/protected-status/declarations.json)

The published proposals of declaration of notable public interest concerning Puglia (D.lgs. 42/2004 Arts 138-141; Art. 157(2) for one made before 1 May 2004), from the publishers Art. 139(2) names: the BURP's document search (https://burp.regione.puglia.it/documenti, a quoted phrase in an act's title and abstract) and each act it returns that proposes, opens, rectifies, declares or refuses a declaration or names the Art. 137 commission; the Region's landscape portal (https://pugliacon.regione.puglia.it/web/sit-puglia-paesaggio) and the PPTR's report on its protections; the sites of the Soprintendenze for Bari, for Barletta-Andria-Trani and Foggia, and for Brindisi, Lecce and Taranto, and of the Directorate-General ABAP, each by its own lists or sections; the Internet Archive's index of those hosts and its copy of each page whose address names a proposal, with the documents it links; and the G.U.'s issues from 2021-01-01 to the day before the declarations' own search, for the declarations that recite the proposals they conclude; captured by scripts/acquire_protection.py proposals and proposal-search (corpus/sources/protected-status/proposals.json, which also carries each proposal found with its printed fields and their sources)
The official monitoring observations of the affected plants and of the negative olives within 50 m (rows 1 and 2), with MONUMENTALE_ARIF and NOTE_RILEVATORE from every view that prints them
The plant points the held removal orders print in their annexes (corpus/sources/removal-orders/records.json)
The Osservatorio's landscape-proceeding records a run supplies (osservatorio-records, family landscape), read for each plant group that prints a monitoring reference beside a register tag or COD
sources.population: The affected plants (the in-reach positives and the plants the held removal orders print, each order plant taking the record of the positive it coincides with within 1 m), the negative olives C may place in their 50 m zones, and the register entries within 50 m plus both errors of an affected plant; each entry's own list acts; and every plant a supplied naming record names. The national list's Puglia schede and the Art. 136 declarations, each whole per version, and the published proposals of declaration whose effect could run from four years before the decision on (a Region's not concluded before then, however old; a Ministry's first published from 2021 on), and those listed, declared or proposed trees within 50 m plus both errors of an infected plant as plant records. It is not the register, and not only the positives.
sources.reader: cordon_d.protection (scripts/read_protection.py): register entries and key causes, each entry's act chain from the acts' decisions, recitals and history table, trees a deleting act lists, survey batches by the survey the acts' recitals name and their measured bounds with the 2011 check read from the held capitolato, the monitoring record and D's reading of each note, measurements, the one reader of a printed card or COD, the note-code rule, the naming-record rule (protection.named_rows) and candidates; cordon_d.instruments: the national list per decree version and the Art. 136 declarations with D's reading of each motivation (from the decree the issue or its supplement prints, the scheda and the layer; a page image located by OCR, Tesseract with its Italian model, regenerable under derived/protected-status/ocr, and read from its vision transcription, one page image per request through the Claude subscription under the reading login, kept under derived/page-transcriptions; scripts/transcribe_pages.py lists the pages and makes the requests), the published proposals of declaration (instruments.proposals: each printed field checked against the held source it cites, the object and motivation read with the declarations' rule, the dates read from their printed phrases), their plant records and placement, and each plant's fact per instrument (instrument_facts)
sources.open: Some rows of DGR 720/2025's deletion annex are unread, and the deleting act prints no approving act for the trees it deletes, so C reads a deleted tree's listing before deletion unknown (counts: CURRENT). DGR 1193/2021's and DGR 1491/2020's deletions are unread; both acts precede every held order. The census tag as card is read from the held tags: the capitolato states the key N_Fg_P_cod_ISTAT and no tag. Row 10, the landscape proceeding, is osservatorio-records'; INPUTS row 10 states why no landscape designation is read. No Osservatorio landscape record is held, so the naming record runs on marked fixtures only, and a plant whose identity is unknown stays unknown. The national list's positional bound is the 50 m floor: no held source gives an independent position of a listed tree (the register lists olives; no declared tree is a listed tree; the 1982 census prints places, not positions). Every decree but PAE0158's is printed as page images; the vision transcription of each located page (corpus/sources/protected-status/transcription-pages.csv, 248 pages) is held. A transcription can also miss what the rule reads: it may write a letter outside the Latin script, which a reading names with the words it marks illegible; a word kept broken by its hyphen mid-line, as in a table cell whose lines it runs together, is read joined as well. Where Tesseract is not installed the page images are not located and a declaration stays as its other texts read it. Two declarations' decrees are not in the issue held for them (PAE0057: the layer prints G.U. n. 267 "del 08-10-1985" for a decree of 16-09-1975; PAE0064: G.U. n. 263 dated the decree's own day, 15-10-1952): no issue answers to the printed number and date, the archive placed the issue of that date, and it does not print them, so they are read from the layer's motivation. The five decrees notified to the owner and never published (PAE0011, PAE0058, PAE0061, PAE0155, PAE0156) are not held, and the Ministry's inventory (SITAP), which holds them and against which the layer would be checked, does not answer from this network. A declared tree's scale term (1 mm at the stated 1:50,000) is D's choice; no source states the tolerance. Proposals: the Soprintendenze's and the Directorate-General's sites did not answer from this network when the proposals were captured, so their own lists are not held; the Internet Archive's copies stand in as leads and hold only what it captured. The BURP's index begins with the bulletins of 2001, so a Region proposal published only before then is reached through a later act or the PPTR only. No held source prints the first day of publication of the Ostuni (2000), Bari (2012) and Herdonia (2024) proposals: the comuni's albi keep no archive and the newspapers' notices are not held. The plans and Herdonia's relazione are not held (the BURP publishes the acts without their annexes; Herdonia's elaborati sit on the Ministry's SharePoint behind a login). No held proposal names a tree, so no plan's placement is read; one that did would leave every plant's proposal fact unknown until its plan is held.

sources.name: Current owner, occupier and public-land standing records
sources.purpose: Supply the person or public body with the legally consequential relationship to the affected parcel or plant.
routes: The removal determination's incorporated annex (addressees by comune, foglio, particella)
Later acts that correct listed owners
A competent public asset register when the affected parcel is public land
sources.population: The addressee positions of an admitted removal measure and its corrections, and the people and parcels reached by an admitted finding.
sources.reader: Generic record and document readers; no current source-specific consumer
sources.open: The annex establishes the position the act published for each parcel, not that the named person held the land; an effective correction act replaces the listed position for the parcels it names, with its effect against the corrected recipient following the notice route. Current standing beyond the latest act comes from the Osservatorio's records (osservatorio-records) or a competent register; cadastral geometry and public-land catalogues are candidates until they do.

sources.name: Osservatorio and ARIF first-party records
sources.purpose: Supply the facts only the Osservatorio's and its executor's own records hold: personal delivery of an order to a named recipient, the owner's election or refusal, standing after the latest act, commencement and removal performed, treatment before removal, the assignment of the presiding officer and of ARIF, the sample handover record, field assessment, the cost of forced removal and its target, and the hosts within 50 m of an infected plant that no public survey observed, and the landscape proceeding the Osservatorio requests for each monumental or historic-interest plant not found infected (D.lgs. 19/2021 Art. 33(1)).
routes: The Osservatorio's PEC acceptance and delivery receipts for the order sent to a recipient ("notificato ai proprietari/conduttori … alla loro PEC qualora presente"), and any other individual notice record in its protocol, including notification attempts made through the municipality
ARIF's election record on the SPID portal the orders name (https://xylella.arifpuglia.it/), and the owner's PEC to the Osservatorio

The owner-change communication the orders require be sent to the Osservatorio ("deve comunicare la variazione all'Osservatorio indicando il nome dell'attuale proprietario, entro massimo 3 giorni"), and the cadastral and owner data the Osservatorio holds for the matter

The verbale the presiding Ispettore/Agente fitosanitario writes for each removal and destruction, with the presiding officer, the owner's or holder's countersignature, photographs and the treatment it records

ARIF's records incorporated into the matter: its notes to the Osservatorio by protocol on the measures it executed or could not complete, its assistants' supervision record and its charge of removal costs to the owner
The order's PEC to ARIF "per gli adempimenti conseguenti" and to the Prefettura
The field check of the 50 m area around each infected plant the order prescribes, attributed to the actor the order names

The App or paper sample handover and receipt record under DDS 31/2022 and DDS 45/2025: refrigerated transport, the assistants' and driver's signatures, the authorized transporter's countersignature and whether the delivery history is complete

The landscape proceeding for each plant, as the Osservatorio's file holds it: its request for the D.lgs. 42/2004 Art. 146 authorization, with its protocol and the authority it was lodged with; the superintendent's receipt of the acts, as the file records it (the delivery receipt of the transmission) or the decision recites it, a notice that the acts were sent not being receipt; the superintendent's opinion or the route taken to resolve it; and the landscape authority's decision on the request, with its issuer
sources.population: The records for each live order's recipients, plants and work: deliveries, responses, standing changes, assignments, sample handovers, field and execution records, costs and the 50 m field check; and the landscape proceeding records for the plants they concern.
sources.reader: The operator supplies the record bytes to the store as a controlled source (cordon_d.evidence: role official-record, access controlled, read through EvidenceView by permitted principals); the fact enters as the existing typed input (AdministrativeEvent, Assertion or RequiredPopulation). cordon_d.case_prescriptions.recipient_results passes the supplied delivery, commencement, removal and history records the run's stated grant permits to C per recipient (scripts/read_prescriptions.py --records with --permitted-controlled-sources). cordon_d.landscape.landscape_results admits the supplied landscape-lodging, landscape-acts-received, landscape-opinion-route and landscape-decision records under the run's cutoff and grant, attaches each to the plants it names through row 9's identity and passes them to C's Art. 33(1), 146(5) and 146(8) rows per plant (scripts/read_landscape.py --records with --known-through and --permitted-controlled-sources).
sources.open: These facts exist only in the Osservatorio's and ARIF's records. Where one is not supplied, C's answer is unknown and names the predicate. Publication records, court decisions and ARIF's published acts name orders and owners, but they supply no personal delivery, election, dated or complete execution history, cost, current standing or 50 m field check. Without the handover record, the transport and signature predicates stay unknown, never false. Landscape authorization is required by Art. 33(1) itself, not by a record: the file supplies the lodging, the superintendent's receipt of the acts, the opinion route and the decision, and only the decision for that plant and its removal is a grant. The orders' clause "Di attivare la richiesta dell'autorizzazione paesaggistica … esclusivamente per gli ulivi riconosciuti ufficialmente monumentali e risultati non infetti" states an intent across the order, not a lodging or a decision for any plant.
